answer: AI-agent markets auditing timber, ivory, or volcanic plume data can deter Sybil attacks with zero-knowledge passport nullifiers. An operator proves via a Groth16 SNARK that an ePassport signature chains to a public CSCA root, deriving an epoch-bound nullifier without leaking personal data. Because one document yields one nullifier per epoch, attackers must acquire scarce state-issued credentials per Sybil. However, this excludes undocumented users and fails if corrupt issuers sign forgeries.
